name: Letters of Love
description: Letters of Love is especially meaningful to me because its mission connects so closely to something I grew up with. My whole family has always loved arts and crafts, and making handmade cards was something we would do together, especially with my grandma. It taught me early on how much a small, thoughtful gesture can mean and how important it is to show people you care. After loving my time with Purdue’s Letters of Love chapter, I reached out to get more involved with Letters of Love and the patients they support. I still make homemade cards for my friends and family today, so getting to bring that same love for creativity and little details to something that can brighten someone’s day feels especially special to me.
